featured.rule:
### Event Rules for Participants  
* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.  
* Participants should park at their designated slots.  
* Convoy participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.
* Participants must haul a trailer during the convoy. 
* Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited.
* Cars including alternating vehicles are prohibited except for TruckersMP Event Staff assisting with the event. 
* Buses are prohibited.
* Overtaking is strictly prohibited.  
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
* All Other TruckersMP Rules Apply.  

### Event Rules for Event Staff  
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.  
* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.  
* All Other **[TruckersMP Rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules)** Apply.

now.description:
# 🟦🟥 TCCR 4TH ANNIVERSARY

## “Choose Your Route”  

Four years of making history, building a community and creating unforgettable events…  
Today, it’s your turn to choose your destination.  

Inspired by **The Matrix**, you’ll have two options:  
🔵 The Blue Route  
🔴 The Red Route  

Both routes will take you to the same destination… but the journey will depend on your decision.  

---

## 📅 General Information  

🗓 **Date:** NOv 22, 2026  
🕒 **Meeting Time:** 18:00 UTC  
🎉 **Truck Fest:** 19:00 UTC  
🚛 **Departure Time:** 19:30 UTC  
📍 **Final Destination:** Budapest  
🧩 **DLC Required:** Going East!  
🌐 **Server:**  

---

# 🔵 BLUE ROUTE  

### “Stay in the Comfort Zone”  

📍 **Departure:** Katowice  

A strategic, elegant and organised route.  
Perfect for those who rely on structure and coordination.  

---

# 🔴 RED ROUTE  

### “Discover the Truth”  

📍 **Start:** TruckersMP HQ  

An imposing start, straight from the heart of the simulation.  
For those seeking presence and character from the very first kilometre.  

---

# 🎉 Truck Fest & Awards – 4th Anniversary  

Both routes will converge in **Budapest** to celebrate our grand **official Truck Fest**, where we will reward excellence and community commitment.  

## 🏆 Official Categories  

🥇 **Best VTC Attendance**  
The VTC with the highest confirmed participation and presence at the event.   
 
🚛 **Best VTC Parking**  
Organisation, alignment, discipline and presentation during the Truck Fest.  

🤝 **Best Partner Attendance**  
Special recognition for the partner with the greatest support and presence.  

🌟 **Best Public Truck**  
The independent driver with the most creative, eye-catching and well-presented truck.  

---

## 🎊 Why is this event different?  

Because we’re not just celebrating years…  
We’re celebrating perseverance.  
We’re celebrating evolution.  
We’re celebrating community.  

Four years don’t come around every day.  
And this anniversary won’t just be a convoy…  

It will be history.

### Blue Event supervised by: TCCR Events  [![](https://zupimages.net/up/25/42/ejjs.png)](https://tccrgroup.cc/discord)

### Red  Event Supervised by Orvion Convoy Control
[![](https://i.imgur.com/Mj9uXv5.jpeg)](https://discord.gg/Qyjbvu2Ygt)

### Real Ops Created and implemented by: TCCR Events  [![](https://zupimages.net/up/25/42/hjjo.png)](https://tccrgroup.cc/discord)

* The Event Staff are recognized as; “Elite | Staff" or similar.

* Free roaming on the server is prohibited

* Impersonating Event Staff using the aforementioned tags is forbidden.

* Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)

* Cars and Buses are prohibited except for event staff showing a clear tag.

* Participants must haul a trailer. (Except Event Staff)

* Participants with consistent lag must remain at the back of the convoy.

* Advertising on the server is prohibited. (Except Event Staff)

* Overtaking on the server is prohibited.

* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.

* Participants should park at their designated slots. If you do not have a designated slot you are required to park in the 'Public Parking' area.

* Participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.

All other TruckersMP rules apply.

⭐ **Event Rules for Event Staff**


*Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.

*Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. In accordance with the rule above.

*Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.

*Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff

All other TruckersMP rules apply.
